source.note: phoneDSH-only contract vector; no dsh-bot upstream file exists. The source.checkout records the pinned upstream batch this contract sits beside, not the origin of these cases.

delta: source.rpcId prefix -> turn origin, hidden, held block and memory source (P26/P27, PC-20261110-bot-turn-origin)
valid: every row of the turn-origin table plus both task-wake prefixes
invalid: empty, prefix-only, case-shifted, embedded, whitespace-only payload, missing/null and legacy bare tool call ids must resolve to unknown (visible, agent-message)

invalid.name: empty
invalid.reason: empty request ids carry no origin

invalid.name: prefix-only-user-action
invalid.reason: a bare prefix has no payload and is not a host-constructed request id

invalid.name: prefix-only-bot
invalid.reason: the default visible id always appends a UUID

invalid.name: prefix-only-held
invalid.reason: held delivery ids always append the item digest

invalid.name: prefix-only-agent
invalid.reason: agent delivery ids always append the sender tool call id

invalid.name: prefix-only-routine
invalid.reason: routine ids always append the run id

invalid.name: prefix-only-task-turn
invalid.reason: task ids always append the task id

invalid.name: prefix-only-task-settled
invalid.reason: task wake ids always append the task id

invalid.name: prefix-only-task-interrupted
invalid.reason: task wake ids always append the task id

invalid.name: uppercase-user-action
invalid.reason: prefix matching is ASCII case-sensitive

invalid.name: mixed-case-routine
invalid.reason: a case-shifted hidden prefix must not hide the turn

invalid.name: uppercase-task-turn
invalid.reason: a case-shifted hidden prefix must not hide the turn

invalid.name: user-action-in-middle
invalid.reason: the prefix is only recognised at offset 0

invalid.name: held-in-middle
invalid.reason: a held marker in the middle is ordinary text

invalid.name: agent-after-newline
invalid.reason: a leading newline means the id does not start with the prefix

invalid.name: routine-after-space
invalid.reason: leading whitespace is not trimmed before matching

invalid.name: legacy-bot-call-id
invalid.reason: pre-WP4 bot-to-bot messages used the sender tool call id without a prefix

invalid.name: legacy-tool-use-id
invalid.reason: bare tool-call-shaped ids are unknown, never hidden

invalid.name: agent-dash-not-colon
invalid.reason: agent- is not the agent: delimiter

invalid.name: user-action-no-colon
invalid.reason: the colon is part of the prefix

invalid.name: task-settledness
invalid.reason: only the exact task-settled: prefix is a hidden wake

invalid.name: bot-underscore
invalid.reason: bot_ is not the bot- prefix

invalid.name: fullwidth-routine
invalid.reason: fullwidth lookalikes are not the ASCII prefix

invalid.name: routine-whitespace-only
invalid.reason: a whitespace-only payload is not a run id

invalid.name: agent-newline-only
invalid.reason: a whitespace-only payload is not a call id

invalid.name: missing-rpc-id
invalid.reason: an absent source.rpcId is unknown

invalid.name: null-rpc-id
invalid.reason: a null source.rpcId is unknown
